message: Here are 7 construction hazards I identified from the image

hazards.title: Worker on trailer deck edge
hazards.description: A worker stands near the edge of the flatbed trailer deck at left among wrapped pallets, with no fall protection visible, exposed to a fall of several feet to the ground.
hazards.category: Working at Heights and Fall Protection

hazards.title: Forklift operating near pedestrians
hazards.description: A forklift travels in the center of the roadway close to workers unloading the truck and a worker walking on the adjacent walkway, with no physical separation or spotter visible.

hazards.title: Worker beside load during unloading
hazards.description: A worker at ground level beside the trailer reaches up to steady a large wrapped pallet load on the deck and could be struck if the load shifts or falls.

hazards.title: Pipes stacked on slope
hazards.description: Large black pipes are stacked on timber supports on the sloped dirt embankment at right, held by wooden stakes and straps, and could roll or slide if the supports shift.

hazards.title: Loose straps across walkway
hazards.description: Tangled green straps lie loosely across the concrete walkway and onto the road edge in the foreground, creating a trip hazard for pedestrians.

hazards.title: Muddy, rutted travel surface
hazards.description: The roadway on the left is wet, muddy and rutted with puddles, creating slip and trip hazards for workers on foot.

hazards.title: Materials stored along walkway edge
hazards.description: Wrapped pallets of material are placed directly beside the walkway in the right foreground, crowding the pedestrian route.
